description: Send and receive files with the official LocalSend apps

store.summary: AirDrop-style file sharing with the LocalSend apps on your phone and PC
store.description: Send files, folders and text between your CardputerZero and any device running LocalSend (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux) over your local Wi-Fi. No cloud, no account. Incoming transfers pop up for approval, or turn on Quick Save to accept automatically. Uses the open LocalSend v2.1 protocol with HTTPS.
